property.name: sectionNames
property.label: Section Names
property.description: Semicolon-separated list of section heading names, one per column. Example: Our Offices;Contact Us

property.name: navigationNames
property.label: Navigation Items
property.description: Pipe-separated item labels within each section; semicolons separate sections. Must match the order of Section Names. Example: London Office|Manchester Office;Email Us|Call Us

property.name: navigationLinks
property.label: Navigation URLs
property.description: Pipe-separated URLs in the same order as Navigation Items; semicolons separate sections. Use full URLs for external links (https://...) or site-relative paths (/page) for internal pages. Example: https://maps.google.com/...|https://maps.google.com/...;mailto:info@example.com|tel:+44

property.name: columnTypes
property.label: Column Type
property.description: Semicolon-separated values, one per section. Enter 1 for a single-column list or 2 for a two-column list. Must match the order of Section Names. Example: 2;1

property.name: privacyPageName
property.label: Privacy Page API Name
property.description: API name of the Privacy page as set in Experience Builder (Page Properties > API Name). Do not include the domain or site path — the component resolves the URL automatically.

property.name: cookiesPageName
property.label: Cookies Page API Name
property.description: API name of the Cookies page as set in Experience Builder (Page Properties > API Name). Do not include the domain or site path — the component resolves the URL automatically.

property.name: accessibilityPageName
property.label: Accessibility Statement Page API Name
property.description: API name of the Accessibility Statement page as set in Experience Builder (Page Properties > API Name). Do not include the domain or site path — the component resolves the URL automatically.

property.name: hideLicenceBar
property.label: Hide Licence Bar
property.description: Tick to hide the Open Government Licence bar. Leave unticked for public sector projects.

property.name: licenceBarPrefix
property.label: Licence Bar Prefix Text
property.default: All content is available under the
property.description: Text appearing before the OGL link in the licence bar.

property.name: licenceBarSuffix
property.label: Licence Bar Suffix Text
property.description: Text appearing after the OGL link in the licence bar.

property.name: headingColour
property.label: Section Heading Colour
property.description: Colour of the section name headings as a hex value (e.g. #ffffff). Must meet WCAG AAA contrast against the background colour.

property.name: navLinkColour
property.label: Navigation Link Colour
property.description: Colour of the navigation item links within each section as a hex value (e.g. #CECBF6). Must meet WCAG AAA contrast against the background colour.

property.name: metaLinkColour
property.label: Meta Link Colour
property.description: Colour of the Privacy, Cookies and Accessibility Statement links as a hex value (e.g. #CECBF6). Must meet WCAG AAA contrast against the background colour.

property.name: backgroundColour
property.label: Background Colour
property.description: Main footer background colour as a hex value (e.g. #382573). Leave blank to inherit from the theme CSS custom property --branded-footer-bg.

property.name: barBackgroundColour
property.label: Licence Bar Background Colour
property.description: Licence bar background colour as a hex value (e.g. #1a0f40). Leave blank to inherit from the theme CSS custom property --branded-footer-bar-bg.

property.name: focusColour
property.label: Focus Ring Colour
property.description: Focus indicator colour as a hex value (e.g. #ffdd00). Leave blank to inherit from the theme CSS custom property --branded-footer-focus.
